name: What are the common signs of mold growth after a roof leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of mold growth after a roof leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of mold growth include a musty or earthy odor, visible discoloration on walls, ceilings, or personal belongings (often black, green, or white patches), and peeling paint or wallpaper. You might also notice increased allergy-like symptoms in occupants, such as sneezing, coughing, or eye irritation, especially when indoors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include musty odors, visible discoloration on surfaces, peeling paint, and allergy-like symptoms.
